objectives:
"Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is an important topic in academic and practical field.
The purpose of this course is to learn the reporting standards and the components of the CSR report, and to learn the methods of the CSR report analysis. By the end of this course, participants are expected to select a specific topic concerning CSR report analysis for a deeper study and to write an academic paper."
content:
"Introduction of the course
Seminar on the history of CSR reporting
Seminar on CSR strategy execution and CSR indicators selection
Seminar on CSR reporting framework
Seminar on CSR reporting quality
Presentation of research proposal
Seminar on the evolvement of GRI (Global Reporting Initiative)
Seminar on GRI 101: Foundation
Seminar on GRI 102: General Disclosures
Seminar on GRI 103: Management Approach
Management Approach
Seminar on GRI 200: Economic Standards
Seminar on GRI 300: Environmental Standards
Seminar on GRI 400: Social Standards
Discussion on research progress of research proposal
Seminar on relationship between CSR disclosure and financial performance
Seminar on relationship between CSR disclosure and operational performance
Presentation of the final research paper
Presentation of the final research paper"
